user_quote: 我们暂时把一个全局自洽的瞬间定为一次‘心跳’，统一命名和明确概念。
definition: A single global self-consistent instantaneous configuration of the declared model and its boundaries; the term denotes the state/event, not the transition or a solver iteration.

index_types.k: solver iteration for the SAME candidate

global_means: all modeled variables AND declared boundary/source response; not a claim of simulating the actual entire universe
numeric_iterates: CANDIDATES; only accepted after declared consistency checks; approximate status and tolerances mandatory
unknown_or_truncated_external_response: retain as boundary residual or mark SCOPE_OPEN; never label a fragment universal-global
input_policy: initial preparation and force/interaction controls; no prescribed output angle or endpoint displacement without a declared clamp/servo model
memory_policy: retain field momenta, branch state, source history and correlations that influence future observations
shor_policy: compile from N,a without inserting unknown order or factors; no speedup implied by naming or self-consistency
legacy_policy: Prior algorithm steps, clock ticks and logical layers remain historical terms; they are not automatically renamed heartbeat snapshots.
physical_law_status: new laws remain explicit research candidates
